title: Revised rating: 3 stars
text: Revised rating: 3 stars. Had this less than 2 months and the lid already broke. Going to have to resume my search and hope to find a water bottle that can hold up to life.

product_metadata.title: THERMOS Hydration Bottle with Rotating Meter, 24 oz
features: 24 Ounce Hydration Bottle with Meter, Clear
Rotating meter lets you monitor your daily water consumption
Easy opening hygienic push button sipper lid with locking ring
Ergonomic design is comfortable to grip; 24 ounce capacity
One handed push button lid operation; Flip up carrying loop
description: Nothing is more vital to staying healthy and fit than proper hydration. This 24-ounce Hydration Bottle from Genuine Thermos Brand makes it easier with features including a rotating meter integrated into the lid to help keep track of consumption, an ergonomically-designed body for a comfortable grip, and a push button lid with a locking ring and carry loop.
